title: Describing a Sketch
summary: Students integrate earlier Module 1 vocabulary to describe a fashion sketch clearly and in a logical order, ending with one structured written sketch-description card and one short oral presentation.
essential_question: How can I describe a fashion sketch clearly in simple English?
professional_context: Week 10 connects English to beginner portfolio caption language and short in-class sketch presentation language. Students combine garment, detail, color, silhouette, fabric, and design-comment vocabulary to explain one visible sketch clearly from general information to specific details.
language_focus: integrated sketch-description frames such as This is a fashion sketch, The figure is wearing, and The garment has
visible-detail language for garment parts, color palette, silhouette, and fabric ideas
teacher_preparation: Preview the opener sketch board, the reading and presentation sketch gallery, and the listening sketch gallery before class.
Keep visible sentence frames for This is a fashion sketch, The figure is wearing, The garment has, The color palette is, The silhouette is, I imagine this garment in, and The overall look is.
Keep the main writing task line-based and scaffolded. Do not turn the Fashion Sketch Description Card into a paragraph or word-count assignment.
Check that the Week 10 listening gallery keys image A to image D, the audio script, the question labels, and the correct answers all match exactly.
Prepare quick correction support for is wearing, color palette is, plural details, adjective order, and I chose ... because ....
Decide whether students will use projected sketch galleries, printed sketch cards, or teacher-selected visual references during the speaking session.
student_deliverables: Completion of the Week 10 opener selections.
Completion of the main sketch-description vocabulary matching and sorting set.
Reading-comprehension responses matching three sketch descriptions to image A, image B, or image C and answering detail questions.
Listening-comprehension responses identifying sketches and details from one short numbered listening clip.
Completion of one ordered sketch-description sequence plus two support checks.
Completion of sketch-description phrase-practice fill blanks.
A scaffolded Fashion Sketch Description Card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge sentence.
Two corrected Week 10 sketch-description sentences saved after review.
A short teacher-observed oral presentation describing one sketch.
